guidance.metric_label: Relays: pilot supplies in H2 FY27, ramp-up in FY28
guidance.condition: Third delay: relays were first expected in FY26, then H2 FY27 commercial ramp-up (May 2026 call). The May call's ₹25-50 Cr of FY27 relay revenue now looks unlikely.
guidance.quote: In the Relays business, we expect to make pilot supplies in H2FY27, with a material ramp-up expected in FY28.
guidance.speaker: Sharad Taparia (Managing Director), in the Q2 FY27 press release
guidance.revises: Relays commercial ramp-up in H2 FY27

guidance.metric_label: EV demand steady for the rest of FY27
guidance.condition: Q2 FY27 revenue +49% on EV demand and domestic smart-meter orders; EBITDA margin 24.6%.
guidance.quote: Based on current projections, we expect EV demand to remain at a similar level for the rest of the financial year.
guidance.speaker: Sharad Taparia (Managing Director), in the Q2 FY27 press release

guidance.metric_label: Better alloy furnace utilisation in H2 FY27
guidance.condition: Teething issues at the new furnace kept it from full use in H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect better utilisation of the new furnace capacity in H2FY27.
guidance.speaker: Sharad Taparia (Managing Director), in the Q2 FY27 press release

guidance.metric_label: Quantum Magnetics product approvals to start soon
guidance.condition: Phase 2 was promised for Q3-Q4 FY27 (May 2026 call): kept. Q4 FY27 magnet sales of ₹10-15 Cr also depend on these approvals.
guidance.quote: For Quantum Magnetics, we commissioned the Phase 2 CAPEX, covering block cutting, machining, and surface treatment, in October 2026, in line with the Q3FY27 timeline we shared earlier. The product approval process is expected to start soon.
guidance.speaker: Sharad Taparia (Managing Director), in the Q2 FY27 press release

insights.summary: From the company's Q2 FY27 press release (the call transcript is not yet filed). Standalone Q2 revenue rose 49% to ₹72.5 Cr and EBITDA 159% to ₹17.8 Cr (24.6% margin) on strong EV demand and domestic smart-meter orders; PAT ₹10 Cr. The MD expects EV demand to hold for the rest of FY27 and better use of the new alloy furnace in H2 after teething issues. Relays slip again: only pilot supplies in H2 FY27, with a material ramp-up in FY28. Quantum Magnetics' Phase 2 lines were commissioned in October as promised, with product approvals next.
